buckets.name: Core
buckets.description: Product base types, canonical object types, graph projections, identity resolution and source provenance.

buckets.name: Organization & Identity
buckets.description: Tenants, organizations, teams, people, roles, skills, assignments and explicit ownership boundaries.

buckets.name: Governance & Compliance
buckets.description: What constrains the organization and how it is enforced: the controls it must satisfy, the policies it writes, the rules Studio applies, and the evidence that they held.

buckets.name: Systems & Integrations
buckets.description: Policy-controlled integrations that synchronize source control, documentation, planning, artifacts and tests.

buckets.name: Content & Knowledge
buckets.description: Source-aware repositories, commits, documents, Markdown structures, templates, checklists and normalized text.

buckets.name: Projects & Work
buckets.description: Hierarchical projects, objectives, milestones, risks and configurable work items.

buckets.name: Collaboration
buckets.description: Comprehensive SDLC collaboration across conversations, inline and document discussions, PR reviews, approval requests, decisions, mentions and notifications.

buckets.name: Automation & Controls
buckets.description: Governed workflows, actions, policies, validation, custom durable objects, retryable executions and evidence.

buckets.name: AI
buckets.description: Models, tools, agents, prompts, context snapshots and auditable tool calls.

buckets.name: Kits Management
buckets.description: Versioned Kit packages and their reusable role definitions across lifecycle scopes.

entities.name: Managed Object
entities.description: Studio's representation of one real entity, typed by an Object Type which fixes its scope: shared (one per tenant, attached by project trees) or tree-scoped.

meta.note: Added as the explicit product-domain representation of graph objects. · model.md §3.2

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Fixed by the object type; root_project_ref is set only when scope is project tree

properties.name: root_project_ref
properties.description: Set only when scope is project tree

properties.name: access_level
properties.description: Shared objects only; set at tenant scope

properties.name: allowed_root_project_refs
properties.description: Shared objects with access_level restricted

entities.name: Relation
entities.description: A typed, directed link between exactly two managed objects, scoped shared or to one project tree, with origin, provenance and confidence.

meta.note: Added as the explicit typed directed link between managed objects. · model.md §3.2, §8.1

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Shared relations join two shared objects and are mirrored source facts

properties.name: root_project_ref
properties.description: Set only when scope is project tree

entities.name: Metric
entities.description: A non-instantiable product base for domain-specific and Studio-computed measurements.

entities.name: Knowledge Graph
entities.description: A transient application composition of the tenant's managed objects, relations and graph aggregates for an API or UI response.

meta.note: Computed on request from authoritative objects and relations; never persisted as its own entity.

entities.name: Object Type
entities.description: A tenant-extensible definition of schema, states, relationships, validation and presentation for any lifecycle object.

properties.name: tier
properties.description: Declared by the kit; fixes the scope of every object of this type

properties.name: requires_template
properties.description: The Template objects of this type must structurally conform to.

properties.name: requires_checklist
properties.description: Checklists that must be evaluated against objects of this type.

properties.name: compare_against
properties.description: Other object types this type's instances should be gap/contradiction/bloat-checked against (e.g. a Feature Spec type declaring it must be compared against the Design type).

methods.name: get_parent_type
methods.description: The type this one specializes, if any

entities.name: Relation Type
entities.description: Registered kind of relation that constrains which object types it may connect and mirrors organization-model primary relationships where applicable.

meta.note: Added as the registered relation constraint type activated per project tree. · model.md §3.2, §8.1

entities.name: Provenance
entities.description: Evidence describing where a graph fact came from, how it was derived and when it was observed.

entities.name: Attachment
entities.description: The record that a project tree uses a shared object: who attached it, when, and whether it is still active. Attaching is a tenant-scope right.

meta.note: Added with the shared object scope. · model.md §3.1.1, §3.2

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Retires this project tree relations to the object

examples: Backup & Recovery attaches the cyber-protect repository
Cyber Cloud detaches a decommissioned service

entities.name: Local Overlay
entities.description: A project tree's own attributes on a shared object. Visible only in that project tree and never changes the shared object.

meta.note: Added with the shared object scope. · model.md §3.1.1, §3.4

examples: In our line this repository is release-critical
Local risk rating for a shared service

entities.name: Cross-tree Reference
entities.description: A deliberately weak, one-way pointer from an object in one project tree to an object in another. Not a relation: traversal stops at it and workflows never see it.

meta.note: Added for cross-line dependencies a shared object cannot express. · model.md §3.2, invariant 5c

methods.name: render_target
methods.description: Never returns the target object itself

examples: Our release depends on their component

entities.name: Organization Entity
entities.description: The product base for tenant-owned organization objects represented in the Knowledge Graph.

entities.name: Tenant
entities.description: An isolated commercial, operational and security boundary for one organization and its governed data.

entities.name: Organizational Unit
entities.description: A hierarchical business, functional or geographic unit within an organization, independent of delivery-team topology.

entities.name: Team
entities.description: A durable group of people with ownership and delivery responsibilities; membership is either authored in Studio or mirrored from a source system.

meta.note: Kept as a separate entity: Org Unit is the org chart, Team is cross-functional. Role grants are allowed only on authored teams.

properties.name: acquisition
properties.description: Where the membership comes from; role grants are allowed only on authored teams.

entities.name: Membership
entities.description: Dated participation of a Person in a tenant or a team, and the record that carries the right to enter Studio. A tenant membership is always authored in Studio.

meta.note: Renamed from Member and reshaped: participation in a tenant or a team, one entity at two scopes. · model.md §3.1

properties.name: person_ref
properties.description: The shared Person this membership is about

properties.name: scope_kind
properties.description: tenant means the person uses Studio; team means the person is on that team

properties.name: acquisition
properties.description: Tenant memberships are always authored; a source may create team memberships only

properties.name: allocation
properties.description: Team memberships only

properties.name: owns
properties.cardinality_note: inverse of "View belongs to Tenant / Project / Project / Membership" in §8.1

entities.name: Person
entities.description: A normalized human identity reconciled across source systems; a shared object, one per tenant. Never a grantee of roles.

meta.note: Shared object at tenant level. Access hangs off the Membership that references it, never off the Person. · model.md §3.1.1, §5

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Person is a shared type: one object per tenant

entities.name: Person Profile
entities.description: A governed professional profile describing a person's experience, interests, availability and demonstrated skills.

meta.note: Need to remove it probably, Max V.

entities.name: Role
entities.description: A reusable responsibility and capability definition assignable globally or within a project.

entities.name: Permission
entities.description: Concrete right over a resource: read, create, change, connect, run, approve, publish or administer.

meta.note: Added as the concrete right bundled into roles. · model.md §5

properties.name: action
properties.type: read | create | change | connect | run | approve | publish | administer

entities.name: Role Grant
entities.description: The fact that a member or team holds a role at a tenant, project tree or project scope.

meta.note: Display name aligned to Role Grant while preserving the existing id. · model.md §5

examples: Person assigned to an organization role
Team assigned to a project role
Agent assigned to an automation role

entities.name: Competency
entities.description: A reusable human or agent capability with proficiency, evidence and applicability to roles, work and actions.

entities.name: Ownership
entities.description: An explicit, time-bounded accountability assignment connecting a person, team or organizational unit to a governed object.

entities.name: User Projection
entities.description: The effective subset one member can see, computed from direct role grants plus grants via teams; every view renders through it.

meta.note: Added as the computed subset a member can see. · model.md §5

entities.name: Control
entities.description: Governance, risk or compliance control represented as a managed object.

entities.name: Policy
entities.description: The organization's own normative document: a security regulation, a retention policy, a code of conduct. Content-backed and versioned; mirrored from a wiki or GRC tool, or authored in Studio. It states the commitment; Data Policy and Safety Constraint are what enforce it.

meta.note: Rewritten from a generic Studio rule into the organization document §9 asks for. · model.md §9

properties.name: content_ref
properties.description: The document itself, versioned

properties.name: policy_kind
properties.type: security | privacy | data_retention | engineering | compliance | other

methods.name: list_enforcements
methods.description: The Data Policies and Safety Constraints that enforce this document

entities.name: Data Policy
entities.description: Rule for sensitivity, retention, redaction, model usage and visibility over object types and sources.

meta.note: Added for sensitivity, retention, redaction, model usage and visibility rules. · model.md §5

entities.name: Safety Constraint
entities.description: Rule preventing unsafe automation such as unauthorized write-back, sensitive-data exposure or uncontrolled model usage.

meta.note: Added as automation guardrails over actions, workflows, agents, tools and model routing. · model.md §5

entities.name: Governance Evidence
entities.description: Organization governance evidence represented as a managed object, distinct from Studio execution Evidence.

entities.name: Source System
entities.description: External system holding original records such as Jira, GitLab, Confluence, HRIS, CRM, CI/CD or monitoring.

meta.note: Added to separate external systems of record from graph-represented tooling. · model.md §4

properties.name: kind
properties.type: identity_directory | source_control | documentation | planning | ci_cd | registry | testing | observability | incident_management | support | crm | hris | other

entities.name: SCM App Installation
entities.description: Studio registered as an installed application on a source-control provider (e.g. a GitHub App), subscribed to webhook events for a set of repositories instead of polling them.
examples: A GitHub App installed on an organization's repositories
A GitLab App integration subscribed to merge-request events

entities.name: Connector Type
entities.description: A registered, versioned definition of an integration category, its normalized capabilities, supported auth mechanisms and event schema, used to configure and validate Connector instances.

properties.name: category
properties.type: identity_directory | source_control | documentation | planning | ci_cd | registry | testing | observability | incident_management | support | cloud | developer_tool | ai_provider

entities.name: Connector
entities.description: A policy-controlled integration configuration that ingests external records, normalizes them into Studio objects and may write approved changes back.

properties.name: kind
properties.type: identity_directory | source_control | documentation | planning | ci_cd | registry | testing | observability | incident_management | support | cloud | developer_tool | ai_provider

entities.name: Source Record
entities.description: One original record as fetched from a source system; maps to at most one managed object per project tree.

meta.note: Added as fetched original records mapped per project tree. · model.md §4

entities.name: Source Link
entities.description: The pair of managed object and source record where provenance and per-link sync state live.

meta.note: Added as the managed-object/source-record provenance pair. · model.md §4

entities.name: Sync Run
entities.description: One synchronization execution that imports, updates, reconciles and checks source records.

meta.note: Added as synchronization execution over imports, updates and reconciliation. · model.md §4

entities.name: Sync State
entities.description: Synchronization status per source link answering whether Studio still matches the source.

meta.note: Added as source-link sync status, distinct from validation status. · model.md §4

properties.name: status
properties.type: in_sync | pending | stale | conflicted | error | paused

entities.name: Conflict
entities.description: Detected inconsistency between Studio and one or more sources; first-class so resolution work can target it.

meta.note: Added as a first-class source inconsistency object. · model.md §4

entities.name: Synchronization Checkpoint
entities.description: Configured point where Studio checks that handoffs, sources, work products and relations are in sync.

meta.note: Added as configured handoff/source consistency checkpoints. · model.md §7

entities.name: Canonical Identity
entities.description: Identity of a shared object: the stable id that reconciles equivalent records from external systems into one object per tenant, without losing their source-native identities. Never spans tree-scoped objects.

meta.note: Scoped to shared objects; merge() and split() removed, they could join tree-scoped objects. · model.md §3.1.1, invariant 2

properties.name: scope
properties.description: Serves shared objects only; tree-scoped objects are resolved by Identity Mapping

methods.name: link_source
methods.description: Attaches another source record to this identity

methods.name: unlink_source
methods.description: Detaches a source record; never merges or splits objects across project trees

examples: Person across AD, GitHub and Jira

entities.name: Object Mapping
entities.description: A versioned mapping from an external schema and lifecycle into canonical Studio object types, fields, states and relationships.

meta.note: Type-level mapping: which external type becomes which Studio type, with its field and state mappings and a version. Composes Field Mapping rather than duplicating it.

entities.name: Identity Mapping
entities.description: Rule or confirmed fact that several source records are the same real entity in one importing project tree.

meta.note: Added to preserve tree-local identity merge/split semantics. · model.md §4, §8.2

links.note: Complementary since the shared scope: Canonical Identity resolves shared objects, Identity Mapping resolves tree-scoped ones

examples: Jira user + GitLab account + HRIS row

entities.name: Field Mapping
entities.description: Mapping between source-record fields and managed-object attributes, configured per connector and object type.

meta.note: Added for source-record field to managed-object attribute mapping. · model.md §4

entities.name: Relationship Mapping
entities.description: Mapping between source-system links and Studio relation types, configured per connector.

meta.note: Added for source-system link to Studio relation-type mapping. · model.md §4

entities.name: Doc Space
entities.description: A provider-owned hierarchy or collection of documents with access boundaries.

meta.note: Max V, do we need it?

entities.name: Repository
entities.description: A versioned source tree and collaboration boundary normalized from a source-control connector.

entities.name: Document
entities.description: A versioned document mirrored from a documentation source while preserving hierarchy and provenance.

entities.name: Commit
entities.description: An immutable repository snapshot with authorship and parent lineage.

entities.name: Text Content
entities.description: Canonical text returned by to_text(), carrying a stable mapping back to its source artifact.

entities.name: Markdown Document
entities.description: A source-aware Markdown artifact with canonical text, dialect, front matter and heading structure that can be generated from a template or normalized from a document or repository file.

entities.name: Repository File
entities.description: A path-addressed file at a specific repository revision; mutations create new revisions rather than changing history.

entities.name: Template
entities.description: A reusable text or Markdown document definition containing canonical source content, variables and structural rules for consistent document creation.

entities.name: Branch
entities.description: A named movable reference to a commit in a repository.

entities.name: Markdown Section
entities.description: A heading-bounded semantic section available only for Markdown content.

entities.name: Text Chunk
entities.description: A bounded segment used for retrieval and analysis, derived reproducibly from text or a section.

entities.name: Glossary Term
entities.description: A term of the customer product domain with a definition; not an Object Type and not a Terminology Override.

meta.note: Added for customer product-domain terminology inside a project tree. · model.md §7

entities.name: Term Mapping
entities.description: Tie between a glossary term and managed objects expressing it; drift raises findings.

meta.note: Added to connect glossary terms to managed objects and surface drift. · model.md §7

entities.name: Template Rule
entities.description: A reusable matching and validation rule for a template, including required, optional or forbidden headings, heading levels, ordering, cardinality and content patterns.
examples: Overview heading is mandatory at level 2
Risks section must not be empty

entities.name: Checklist
entities.description: A versioned set of required or advisory checks used by people, workflows and quality gates.

entities.name: File
entities.description: Any file on file system, binary, text file, markdown, source code

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name of file

entities.name: Project
entities.description: Studio's only hierarchical container of work: a managed graph object whose root defines a project-tree scope and whose children inherit configuration without inheriting data or ownership.

properties.name: owns
properties.cardinality_note: inverse of "View belongs to Tenant / Project / Project / Membership" in §8.1

properties.name: parent_project_ref
properties.description: Null for a root Project; existing children cannot be reparented

properties.name: root_project_ref
properties.description: Computed root of the project tree and its scope handle

properties.name: contains_child
properties.description: Strict project tree; one parent per child

properties.name: selects_profile
properties.description: Kit-defined project requirements

methods.name: attach_root
methods.description: Attach a root Project beneath a parent in the same tenant; existing children cannot be reparented

methods.name: list_project_tree
methods.description: All descendants of this root project, flattened

methods.name: archive_subtree
methods.description: Audit and cascade archival across this Project subtree

methods.name: effective_configuration
methods.description: Resolve the closed D-085 configuration inheritance list

entities.name: Objective
entities.description: A measurable business, product, engineering or operational outcome used to align strategy and delivery.

entities.name: Milestone
entities.description: A significant dated outcome or decision point on a roadmap, product or project.

entities.name: Risk
entities.description: A scoped uncertainty that may affect delivery or outcomes, tracked with probability, impact, ownership, mitigation and evidence.

properties.name: category
properties.type: schedule | cost | technical | security | compliance | operational

entities.name: Work Item
entities.description: A provider-neutral instance of a configurable Work Item Type, retaining source identity and lifecycle history.

entities.name: Work Item Type
entities.description: A configurable schema and lifecycle definition for a class of work, without imposing one delivery methodology.

entities.name: View
entities.description: Saved way of selecting and presenting objects through the viewer projection: list, board, table, timeline, dashboard or graph diagram.

meta.note: Added as the saved surface over graph projections and member context. · model.md §3.3

properties.name: view_kind
properties.type: object | traceability | review | graph | insight | dashboard

entities.name: Rendered View
entities.description: A transient API or UI composition produced by applying a saved View and viewer context to authoritative entities.

meta.note: The rendered result is never persisted; the View definition remains authoritative.

properties.name: view_ref
properties.description: Saved View definition used to produce this result

entities.name: Dependency
entities.description: A dated, attributed record that one object depends on another: what blocks what, since when, and how badly. A reified relationship, so its dates and criticality survive.

meta.note: Reified relationship required by invariant 8. · model.md §8.2

properties.name: source_ref
properties.description: The object that depends

properties.name: target_ref
properties.description: The object depended on

examples: Clean Restore blocked by a storage-layer change
A release requires a third-party component upgrade

entities.name: Assignment
entities.description: A dated record that work was allocated to someone: who, to what, in which job role, from when. A reified relationship, distinct from ownership, which is accountability rather than allocation.

meta.note: Reified relationship required by invariant 8. Not the same as Ownership. · model.md §8.2

properties.name: subject_ref
properties.description: The work being allocated

properties.name: job_role
properties.description: The role the assignee acts in for this work

examples: Ivanov assigned to the Clean Restore spec as author
QA team assigned to the release validation

entities.name: Conversation
entities.description: A durable, scoped sequence of messages, context snapshots, tool calls and produced artifacts.

meta.note: Durable AI-assisted session; accepted 2026-08-03.

entities.name: Pull Request
entities.description: A proposed repository change with review, discussion and merge state.

entities.name: Editing Worktree
entities.description: A per-person, per-task isolated filesystem checkout of a Branch that holds exclusive claims on the paths currently being edited, so no two people physically edit the same file at once outside a future co-editing mode.
examples: A developer's isolated checkout for editing docs/prd.md on a feature branch
A reviewer's temporary worktree for verifying a hotfix branch

entities.name: Review Request
entities.description: A routed request for one or more people or teams to review a pull request, document, change, risk or generated proposal.

meta.note: Routes a human review request; accepted 2026-08-03.

properties.name: review_type
properties.type: code | document | architecture | security | release | custom

entities.name: Approval Request
entities.description: A routed request for an explicit approval decision on a candidate change, gate, release, risk acceptance or lifecycle transition.

meta.note: Routes an approval decision, separate from the recorded Approval; accepted 2026-08-03.

entities.name: Review
entities.description: A review decision and discussion for a proposed repository change, including required reviewers and findings.

entities.name: Approval
entities.description: An attributable human or delegated principal decision on a candidate change, quality gate or lifecycle transition.

entities.name: Message
entities.description: An immutable turn carrying typed content, authorship, references, usage and optional tool activity.

meta.note: A turn inside a Conversation, distinct from a Comment on an object.

entities.name: Comment
entities.description: A source-aware comment attached to a pull request or document, with authorship, threading, resolution and edit history.

entities.name: Discussion Thread
entities.description: Ordered set of comments on one subject, resolvable from open to resolved.

meta.note: Added as the grouping object for Studio-native comments. · model.md §6.5

entities.name: Inline Conversation
entities.description: A resolvable conversation anchored to a precise code, diff, document, checklist or generated-output location.

meta.note: Anchored conversation; accepted 2026-08-03.

entities.name: Document Conversation
entities.description: A page, section or document-level conversation used for specification review, design discussion and knowledge capture.

meta.note: Document-level conversation; accepted 2026-08-03.

entities.name: Mention
entities.description: An explicit reference to a person, team, role or actor inside a comment, message or document that can drive notification and follow-up.

meta.note: Explicit attention marker that drives notifications; accepted 2026-08-03.

entities.name: Notification
entities.description: A routed collaboration notification about a lifecycle object, comment, approval, alert or workflow state.

properties.name: notification_type
properties.type: mention | assignment | review | approval | alert | workflow

entities.name: Workflow
entities.description: A versioned graph of actions, decisions, validations, approvals and compensation paths over typed objects.

properties.name: executes_as
properties.cardinality_note: inverse of "Workflow Run executes Workflow" in §8.1

entities.name: Activity
entities.description: Configured unit of work inside a lifecycle stage or workflow, with declared inputs and outputs and performed via actions.

meta.note: Added as configured work units inside stages or workflows. · model.md §7

entities.name: Action
entities.description: A typed operation over objects that may be deterministic, AI-assisted, human-driven or connector-backed.

properties.name: executes_as
properties.cardinality_note: inverse of "Action Run executes Action" in §8.1

entities.name: Worker
entities.description: An isolated executable unit that performs an action with explicit runtime, resource and identity boundaries.

entities.name: Validator
entities.description: A reusable check that evaluates an object, candidate change or execution result against explicit criteria.

entities.name: Quality Gate
entities.description: A required validation and/or approval checkpoint that controls advancement of an object or workflow state.

entities.name: Validation Status
entities.description: Whether an object, candidate or run currently satisfies the validators and quality gates that apply to it.

meta.note: Added as semantic health produced by validators. · model.md §6.1

properties.name: status
properties.type: pass | fail | warning | retry | escalated | blocked

entities.name: Workflow Run
entities.description: A stateful, inspectable execution of one workflow version with retries, approvals and full evidence.

properties.name: status
properties.type: queued | running | waiting | succeeded | failed | cancelled

entities.name: Action Run
entities.description: One durable execution attempt for an action, preserving retry lineage, inputs, outputs, gate results, costs and evidence until a retry passes its Quality Gate or policy is exhausted.

properties.name: status
properties.type: queued | running | waiting | gate_failed | succeeded | failed | cancelled

entities.name: Evidence
entities.description: Stored proof of an input, decision, validation, approval, action, cost or outcome.

entities.name: Audit Entry
entities.description: Immutable record of identity merges/splits, role grants, team membership changes, kit publications, approvals, write-backs and agent actions.

meta.note: Added for immutable administrative and governed-action records. · model.md §6.1, §8.2

properties.name: event_kind
properties.type: identity | role_grant | team_membership | kit_publication | approval | write_back | agent_action

entities.name: Workflow Library
entities.description: Transient catalog of workflows available to a project tree, composed for members to browse and run.

meta.note: Computed from authoritative Workflow definitions and project configuration; never persisted.

entities.name: Automation Rule
entities.description: Standing config rule that reacts to events, sync results or schedules and triggers workflows or actions.

meta.note: Added as standing configuration that reacts to events, syncs or schedules. · model.md §3.3

entities.name: Actor
entities.description: Who acts: a human member, AI agent, external system or pipeline; every action is attributed to an actor.

meta.note: Added to represent attributed human, agent, system or pipeline actors. · model.md §6.1

entities.name: Finding
entities.description: Observed issue over the graph: gap, drift, staleness, contradiction, duplicate, ownership hole or review/scan result.

meta.note: Added as the generic observed graph issue and signal object. · model.md §6.1

links.note: Kit specialization of the generic Finding; renamed to Security Finding to clear the name collision

properties.name: finding_kind
properties.type: gap | drift | stale | contradiction | duplicate | ownership_hole | review | scan | cost_optimization | bloat

properties.name: status
properties.type: detected | acknowledged | triaged | accepted | dismissed | auto_resolved

entities.name: Check
entities.description: One verification step performed while producing a Report — a rule evaluated, a query run, a file scanned, a comparison made — recording what was done and its outcome, whether or not it produced a Finding.
examples: A schema rule evaluated against an Object Type
A cross-document comparison query for contradiction detection
A manual reviewer check of an Approval Request

entities.name: Report
entities.description: The durable result of a validator or reviewer's work over a scope: a versioned aggregate composing the Findings it surfaced and the Checks it performed, with overall status and evidence.
examples: A governance-engine compare_objects run reporting contradiction/gap/bloat findings between a Feature Spec and its Design
A CI-triggered AI-skill review report attached to a Pull Request

entities.name: Governance Alert
entities.description: A signal raised when an event matches a configured Automation Rule condition over the graph — for example, a new Finding of a given kind being detected — routed for attention independent of the general operational/SLO alerting pipeline.

links.note: Name collision with sdlc-full's operational Alert (SLO/capacity/dependency monitoring signal); this is instead a core, event+rule-triggered governance signal, e.g. raised when a specific Finding is detected

examples: A contradiction Finding above a configured severity raises a Governance Alert
A Quality Gate blocking-status change raises a Governance Alert for the responsible team

entities.name: Write-back Capability
entities.description: Configured ability to update a given source system per connector, object type and policy.

meta.note: Added as configured per-connector ability to update a source system. · model.md §6.1

entities.name: Transition
entities.description: Immutable state-change record of a managed object, workflow run or action run; delivery metrics read from transitions.

meta.note: Added as immutable state-change history feeding delivery metrics. · model.md §6.1, Appendix E

properties.name: operation
properties.type: create | update | delete | transition | link | unlink

entities.name: Event
entities.description: A fact that something happened to an object or source, used as a generic automation input.

entities.name: Candidate Object
entities.description: A proposed managed object, relation or content version produced by Studio or an agent but not yet accepted as authoritative.

meta.note: Aligned naming with Candidate Object and repaired bucket ordering after the rename. · model.md §6.1, Appendix B

properties.name: state
properties.type: produced | validating | passed | escalated | awaiting_approval | accepted | dropped

entities.name: Delivery Metric
entities.description: Studio-computed delivery measurement read from transitions and relations, never entered by hand.

meta.note: Added as Studio-computed delivery measurement over transitions and relations. · model.md §6.3

entities.name: Agent Definition
entities.description: The configuration of an AI-assisted worker Studio runs: instructions, tools, model policy, budget and approval boundaries. The definition; its executions are AI Runs.

meta.note: Renamed from Agent: this is the definition Studio runs, not an agent deployed in the organization (that is AI Agent in the SDLC kit).

links.note: An Agent is a specialization of Actor: Actor carries who acts and with what reach, Agent carries the configuration of one AI worker

entities.name: Model Endpoint
entities.description: A provider-neutral point at which Studio calls a model, selected by policy for quality, latency, privacy and cost. Its status describes the access, not the model itself.

meta.note: Renamed from Model: the card describes the endpoint Studio calls, not the model an organization has deployed (that is AI Model in the SDLC kit).

entities.name: Model Routing Policy
entities.description: Rule selecting the AI model or tool per activity type, role, cost, risk or data policy.

meta.note: Added as tenant/project tree-controlled model or tool selection policy. · model.md §6.2

entities.name: Tool
entities.description: A discoverable typed capability callable by an agent, workflow or human through a governed provider.

entities.name: AI Run
entities.description: One execution by a model or agent with model, runtime, cost and token breakdown.

meta.note: Added as the AI execution projection with model and token-cost breakdown. · model.md §6.3

entities.name: Cost Budget
entities.description: Spend cap at tenant, project tree, project, workflow, agent or model scope.

meta.note: Added as scoped AI spend cap and control object. · model.md §6.3

entities.name: Agent Role
entities.description: Specialized role an AI agent plays in an activity, workflow or stage: analyst, implementer, reviewer, tester or summarizer.

meta.note: Added as the AI performer role separate from access roles and org job roles. · model.md §6.2

entities.name: Context Package
entities.description: Selected set of objects, relations, content versions, immutable blobs, rules and evidence handed to an actor for one action or review.

meta.note: Added as the bounded context supplied to a model or actor. · model.md §6.2

entities.name: MCP Server
entities.description: A registered Model Context Protocol endpoint exposing discoverable tools, resources and prompts under policy.

entities.name: Cost Retrospective
entities.description: Computed analysis of a workflow run or phase: plan vs actual tokens/cost, waste sources and cheaper-path recommendations.

meta.note: Added for after-the-fact AI spend analysis and recommendations. · model.md §6.3

entities.name: Prompt Template
entities.description: A model-independent, versioned instruction template with typed variables, examples and evaluation history.

entities.name: Tool Call
entities.description: An auditable request and response for one tool invocation, including approval and side-effect status.

properties.name: status
properties.type: requested | approved | running | succeeded | failed | denied

entities.name: Usage Event
entities.description: Measured Studio activity projection over connector syncs, workflow executions, validations and member activity.

meta.note: Added as computed metering projection over Studio activity. · model.md §6.3

entities.name: Cost Metric
entities.description: Studio-specific computed measurement such as AI cost per accepted change, rolled up per step, phase and workflow.

meta.note: Added for computed AI cost per accepted change and related rollups. · model.md §6.3

entities.name: Project Profile
entities.description: A kit-owned definition of mandatory project fields, lifecycle, connector classes, quality lamps and default views.

entities.name: Kit Catalog
entities.description: Transient composition of shipped and organization-published kits available in the current tenant context.

meta.note: Computed from authoritative Kit and publication data; never persisted as its own entity.

entities.name: Kit
entities.description: A versioned Plan, Build or Operate package that introduces opinionated durable object types, roles, templates, controls, workflows and guidance without changing the core domain model.

meta.note: Extended 2026-08-10 to explicitly model that a Kit can package AI-skill capabilities (Prompt Template, Tool, Agent Definition), not just UI/workflow/type extensions.

entities.name: Kit Activation
entities.description: Versioned, audited project tree decision pinning the exact kit version and enabled capabilities.

meta.note: Added as the version-pinned project tree kit installation decision. · model.md §7, §8.1

entities.name: Construction Lifecycle
entities.description: Kit-defined lifecycle framework with phases, stages, activities and gates; the SDLC Kit ships Plan, Build and Operate.

meta.note: Added as the kit-defined lifecycle framework, not a hard-wired product ladder. · model.md §7

entities.name: Lifecycle Phase
entities.description: A canonical software-construction phase used to classify objects, transitions, gates, evidence and feedback without forcing one methodology.

properties.name: name
properties.type: vision | discovery | strategy | definition | design | construction | validation | release | operation | support | intelligence | optimization | evolution

entities.name: Lifecycle Stage
entities.description: One stage of a kit-defined construction lifecycle, containing activities per performer role and gates.

meta.note: Added for per-role configured activities, gates and checkpoints. · model.md §7

entities.name: Kit Role Definition
entities.description: An opinionated responsibility profile supplied by a Kit and implemented through the generic core Role and Role Assignment objects.

entities.name: Gears
entities.description: Constructor Gears module used by kits and actions as a reusable engine, module or developer/operations tool.

meta.note: Added as Constructor Gears building blocks bundled by kits and actions. · model.md §7

entities.name: Domain Dictionary
entities.description: Configurable vocabulary of a tenant or project tree; project tree-level entries shadow tenant-level ones.

meta.note: Added for tenant/project tree vocabulary with project tree precedence. · model.md §7

entities.name: Reference Catalog
entities.description: Editable named set of allowed values for a field or dimension, with kit defaults and project tree edits.

meta.note: Added as editable value sets for operationally chosen field values. · model.md §7

entities.name: Terminology Override
entities.description: Project- or tenant-specific label for a canonical concept; changes labels, never semantics or relation meaning.

meta.note: Added as label-only customization over canonical concepts. · model.md §7, §8.2

examples: Roadmap Item to Research Plan Item

entities.name: UI Extension
entities.description: Optional sandboxed, version-pinned UI extension shipped by a kit and restricted to authorized host APIs.

meta.note: Added as optional sandboxed UI extension packaged by kits. · model.md §6.4, §7
